entities.summary: Toma Fila is a Serbian lawyer and politician serving as a member of the National Assembly since 3 August 2020. He is also a member of the presidency of the Socialist Party of Serbia (SPS) and a member of the Diocesan Council of the Archbishopric of Belgrade and Karlovci.
